data.description:
## Incident Overview
GHA scanner (gha-scanner.md Step 4) calls list_workflow_runs_for_a_workflow with only status=completed and per_page=10 — no branch parameter is set. This causes it to evaluate the most recent completed run on ANY branch, not just main, producing false-positive bug tickets for PR/worktree branch failures.

**Expected**: scanner should pass branch=main (or the configured default branch) to list_workflow_runs_for_a_workflow so only main-branch CI runs are evaluated.
**Actual**: run 25265466013 on PR branch worktree-20260430-212540 was evaluated, creating a spurious ticket af20-5ba0-0970-4e7e.

**Fix location**: plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/prompts/gha-scanner.md Step 4 — add branch parameter to list_workflow_runs_for_a_workflow call (derive from git remote HEAD or config).
data.title: [GHA Scanner]: workflow runs fetched without branch filter -> scans non-main branches, creates false-positive CI failure tickets
